scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,menu,staff -c blue,magenta,green "npm --prefix apps/api run dev" "npm --prefix apps/menu run dev" "npm --prefix apps/staff run dev"
scripts.build:frontend: npm --prefix apps/menu run build && npm --prefix apps/staff run build
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build:staging && npx wrangler deploy --config apps/menu/wrangler.json --env staging && npx wrangler deploy --config apps/staff/wrangler.json --env staging
